metadata.title: Caribe · Travel across Venezuela
metadata.description: Online travel agency to explore Venezuela: tours, stays and experiences from local agencies.

home.title: Explore Venezuela with Caribe
home.subtitle: Tours, stays and experiences hand-picked by Venezuelan agencies.
home.notReady: Search and bookings arrive in the next phase.
home.featureCatalogDescription: Tours and experiences published and operated by Venezuelan agencies.
home.featureRatesDescription: Every price with its bolívar equivalent at today's rate.
home.featureOfflineDescription: Installable with offline booking access (coming soon).

login.title: Sign in
login.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.metaDescription: Access your Caribe account with email and password.

twoFactor.title: Two-step security
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.metaDescription: Activate or verify the second factor of your Caribe account.
twoFactor.verifyDescription: Open your authenticator app and type the one-time code to finish signing in.
twoFactor.invalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired.
twoFactor.expired: Your sign-in is pending. Please sign in again.
twoFactor.activateDescription: Confirm your password to generate your QR code.
twoFactor.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
twoFactor.scanDescription: Scan the QR with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…) and confirm the code to finish the setup.
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: We show them only once: keep them somewhere safe before continuing.
twoFactor.backupCodesWarning: If you lose your phone, a recovery code lets you sign in. Each works once and they are never shown again: copy them now.
twoFactor.backupCodesEmpty: No codes available right now. You can generate new ones with your password.
twoFactor.regenerateDescription: Lost your codes? Generate new ones with your password.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The route you are looking for does not exist or has changed.
